text:
Zoe: Heads up - PromoPartner issued a mid-cycle marketing rebate for several customers, billing reversed it when eligibility check failed. Vendor invoice arrived 3 days after reversal but with a ~30% disputed line item. Amount invoiced $36,400, disputed $10,920. Need guidance for Nov close on accrual vs deferral for the undisputed amount and treatment for the disputed portion.

Mark: Important: if vendor is disputing part, we should only accrue the undisputed portion. For the disputed $10,920 we should document the dispute and not accrue until resolution. Is there vendor confirmation for the undisputed amount?

Zoe: Vendor email confirms payment for undisputed portion and is contesting the other line as "ineligible promo". Dates: credit applied 2024-11-05, reversal 2024-11-09, vendor invoice dated 2024-11-12. Affected invoices: 8 total; 5 prepaid, 3 usage. Breakdown pasted: 
acct-5001 $15,000 prepaid
acct-5002 $6,480 usage
acct-5003 $5,000 prepaid
acct-5004 $9,920 prepaid
TOTAL billed $36,400 (disputed $10,920 on acct-5004)

Iris: Proposal for close: 1) Accrue vendor payable for undisputed amount = 25,480. 2) Create revenue deferral equal to that amount and amortize prepaid portions over remaining terms. 3) For disputed $10,920, attach vendor dispute email and do not recognize accrual; open an AP dispute ticket.

LedgerBot: Month close lock 2024-11-30 23:59 PST. Any JEs must be posted by 2024-11-29 EOD for review.

Mark: Draft JE for undisputed portion:
Dr Revenue Deferral GL-2170 25,480
  Cr Vendor Accrual GL-2270 25,480
Then reverse usage-recognized amounts immediately (usage total $6,480):
Dr Revenue GL-4020 6,480
  Cr Revenue Deferral GL-2170 6,480
Notes: amortize the remaining prepaid debit across account remaining months (acct-5001 & acct-5003). Memo: "PromoPartner rebate - undisputed amount accrual". Route to finance-leads@redwood.com and cc accounting@redwood.com.

FPandA: Since undisputed accrual >$20k, FP&A notified. Please include invoice scan, vendor confirmation, per-invoice mapping, and AP dispute ticket for the $10,920 disputed portion. Approval required before posting.

Iris: I'll prepare the amort schedule and AP dispute ticket. Zoe please upload vendor email + invoice + billing CSV to Confluence and paste link.

Zoe: Uploading now. Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/FIN/PromoPartner+rebate+Nov24. Routing JE after upload. Thanks everyone.
